# Product page: Trail Runner 2

A product page for our new trail running shoe, Trail Runner 2, on the Stride online store. The store is already a React app with a homepage that links to `/products/trail-runner-2`; build the product page at that address, using mock data, and don't add any packages to the app beyond React and its build tool. For the look, you can take inspiration from this design:

![Trail Runner 2 product page](design.jpg)

- **Store:** the shopper sees the store name and how many items are in their cart.
- **Menu:** the shopper can go to the store's main sections, such as men, women and kids, from the top of the page.
- **Path:** the shopper sees where the shoe sits in the store, such as Shop, Trail, Trail Runner 2, and can go back to any earlier step.
- **Photos:** the shopper sees one photo of the shoe at a time and moves to the next or previous one, going back to the first after the last.
- **Price:** the shopper sees the price and can point at a small "i" next to it to learn that it includes taxes.
- **Color:** the shopper can choose blue, black or grey; only the chosen color shows until they change it, each with a round swatch.
- **Size:** the shopper picks one size from a list that only opens when they want to change it; only the chosen size shows, and sold-out sizes can't be picked.
- **Size guide:** the shopper can open a size chart over the page from next to the size, enter their foot length and choose US or EU to get their size, and must close it to continue.
- **Quantity:** the shopper can choose how many pairs to buy, typing the number or changing it by one.
- **Add to cart:** the shopper adds the shoe to the cart and sees a confirmation; without a size they are asked to pick one.
- **Wishlist:** the shopper can save or unsave the shoe with a heart.
- **More information:** details, reviews and shipping sit side by side below everything, with one section shown at a time.
- **Questions:** a few common questions about the shoe, each with its answer hidden until the shopper opens it.
- **Bottom of the page:** the shopper finds customer help, company and social media links.

# @wcag-tools/playwright

Playwright matchers that check a page against WCAG 2.2 AA and components against their [WAI-ARIA APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/) pattern. When a check fails, the message says how to fix it.

```ts
import { test } from "@playwright/test";
import { expect } from "@wcag-tools/playwright";

test("product page", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/products/trail-runner-2");
  await expect(page).toBeWCAGCompliant();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Size guide" })).toBeAPGModal(["focus-trap", "escape-closes"]);
});
```

`expect` is Playwright's `expect` extended with these matchers.

## Matchers

<!-- matchers:start -->
| Matcher | Asserts | Checks |
|---|---|---|
| `toBeWCAGCompliant` | The page (or a Locator's subtree) meets WCAG 2.2 AA, checked with axe-core plus keyboard, reflow and text-spacing checks. | `text-alternatives`, `structure`, `use-of-color`, `color-contrast`, `resize-text`, `reflow`, `text-spacing`, `keyboard`, `no-keyboard-trap`, `landmarks`, `page-title`, `focus-order`, `link-purpose`, `headings`, `focus-visible`, `focus-not-obscured`, `target-size`, `language`, `labels`, `name-role-value` |
| `toAnnounceStatus` | Pressing Enter on the trigger shows a message that screen readers announce (WCAG 4.1.3); pass `{ field }` for a field error. | `activates-with-keyboard`, `live-region`, `region-present-before`, `focus-kept`, `error-linked` |
| `toBeAPGModal` | Activating the trigger opens a modal dialog (APG Modal Dialog). Called on the trigger. | `opens-with-keyboard`, `role-and-name`, `modal`, `focus-moves-in`, `focus-trap`, `escape-closes`, `focus-returns` |
| `toBeAPGCombobox` | A select-only combobox: shows one value and opens a list (APG Combobox). | `role-and-name`, `collapsed-state`, `opens-with-keyboard`, `controls-listbox`, `arrow-keys`, `enter-selects`, `selected-state`, `disabled-options`, `escape-closes` |
| `toBeAPGTabs` | A tablist: sections side by side, one shown at a time (APG Tabs). | `tablist-name`, `tabs`, `selected-state`, `panels`, `single-tab-stop`, `arrow-keys`, `activation` |
| `toBeAPGTooltip` | The trigger has a tooltip shown on hover and focus (APG Tooltip, WCAG 1.4.13). Called on the trigger. | `described-by`, `text`, `not-focusable`, `shows-on-focus`, `escape-dismisses`, `hides-on-blur`, `shows-on-hover`, `hoverable` |
| `toBeAPGRadioGroup` | A radio group: one of a few visible choices (APG Radio Group). Called on the radiogroup or fieldset. | `role-and-name`, `radios`, `checked-state`, `space-checks`, `arrow-keys`, `single-tab-stop` |
| `toBeAPGSpinbutton` | A spinbutton: a number changed with arrow keys or typed (APG Spinbutton). | `role-and-name`, `value-state`, `arrow-keys`, `bounds`, `home-end`, `accepts-typing` |
| `toBeAPGAccordion` | An accordion: headers that show or hide their panels (APG Accordion). Called on the container. | `header-buttons`, `expanded-state`, `controls-panel`, `toggles-with-keyboard`, `collapsed-hidden`, `tab-order` |
| `toBeAPGBreadcrumb` | A breadcrumb trail (APG Breadcrumb). Called on the nav. | `landmark-and-name`, `ordered-list`, `earlier-steps-are-links`, `current-page` |
| `toBeAPGCarousel` | A carousel: one slide at a time with Previous/Next (APG Carousel). Called on the container. | `container`, `slides`, `controls`, `one-visible`, `wraps`, `live-region`, `rotation-control` |
| `toBeAPGToggleButton` | An on/off button (APG Button, toggle). | `role-and-name`, `pressed-state`, `toggles-with-keyboard`, `name-stable`, `focus-stays` |
| `toBeAPGNavigation` | A site navigation made of links (APG navigation landmark). Called on the nav. | `landmark-and-name`, `links`, `tab-order`, `no-menu-roles`, `current-page` |
<!-- matchers:end -->

Every matcher takes an optional array of check ids first, then its options (`toAnnounceStatus` and `toBeAPGTooltip` take their text first). Without the array, all checks run.

- The matchers use the keyboard only, and restore the widget afterwards. `toAnnounceStatus` is the exception: it really performs the action.
- `.not` is not supported.
- Native `<select>`, `<dialog>` with `showModal()`, radios and `<input type="number">` are accepted.
- `toBeWCAGCompliant` checks the current state of the page, so open a dialog first to check its contents.

+++ b//work/tests/product-page.spec.js
@@ -1,0 +1,164 @@
+import { test } from '@playwright/test'
+import { expect } from '@wcag-tools/playwright'
+
+const productPath = '/products/trail-runner-2'
+
+async function openProductPage(page) {
+  await page.goto(productPath)
+}
+
+test.describe('Trail Runner 2 product page', () => {
+  test('is reachable from the store homepage and identifies the store and cart', async ({ page }) => {
+    await page.goto('/')
+    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Trail Runner 2' }).click()
+
+    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`${productPath}$`))
+    await expect(page.getByRole('banner')).toContainText('Stride')
+    await expect(page.getByText(/cart/i)).toContainText(/0|no items/i)
+  })
+
+  test('offers primary store navigation', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    const navigation = page.getByRole('navigation', { name: /primary/i })
+    await expect(navigation.getByRole('link', { name: /^men$/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(navigation.getByRole('link', { name: /^women$/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(navigation.getByRole('link', { name: /^kids$/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(navigation).toBeAPGNavigation()
+  })
+
+  test('shows an accessible breadcrumb trail', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    const breadcrumb = page.getByRole('navigation', { name: /breadcrumb/i })
+    await expect(breadcrumb).toContainText(/shop/i)
+    await expect(breadcrumb).toContainText(/trail/i)
+    await expect(breadcrumb).toContainText('Trail Runner 2')
+    await expect(breadcrumb).toBeAPGBreadcrumb()
+  })
+
+  test('shows one product photo at a time and wraps photo navigation', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    const photos = page.getByRole('region', { name: /product photos/i })
+    await expect(photos).toBeAPGCarousel()
+  })
+
+  test('exposes the price and a taxes explanation', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    await expect(page.getByText(/\$\s*\d/)).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /tax/i })).toBeAPGTooltip()
+  })
+
+  test('lets shoppers choose exactly one color', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    const colors = page.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: /color/i })
+    await expect(colors).toBeAPGRadioGroup()
+    await expect(colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /blue/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /black/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /grey|gray/i })).toBeVisible()
+
+    await colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /black/i }).check()
+    await expect(colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /black/i })).toBeChecked()
+    await expect(colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /blue/i })).not.toBeChecked()
+  })
+
+  test('lets shoppers choose an available size and prevents sold-out sizes', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    const size = page.getByRole('combobox', { name: /size/i })
+    await expect(size).toBeAPGCombobox()
+    await size.click()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('option', { name: /sold out/i })).toBeDisabled()
+    await size.selectOption({ label: /^(8|9)$/ })
+    await expect(size).toHaveValue(/8|9/)
+  })
+
+  test('opens the size guide as a modal and calculates a size from foot length', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    const sizeGuide = page.getByRole('button', { name: /size guide/i })
+    await expect(sizeGuide).toBeAPGModal()
+    await sizeGuide.click()
+
+    const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: /size guide/i })
+    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
+    await dialog.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /foot length/i }).fill('26')
+    await dialog.getByRole('combobox', { name: /unit|system/i }).selectOption(/us/i)
+    await expect(dialog).toContainText(/size/i)
+    await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: /close/i }).click()
+    await expect(dialog).toBeHidden()
+  })
+
+  test('supports typed and one-step quantity changes', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    const quantity = page.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /quantity/i })
+    await expect(quantity).toBeAPGSpinbutton()
+    await quantity.fill('2')
+    await expect(quantity).toHaveValue('2')
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /increase quantity|add one/i }).click()
+    await expect(quantity).toHaveValue('3')
+  })
+
+  test('requires a size, then confirms a successful add to cart', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /add to cart|add to bag/i }).click()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText(/choose|select.*size/i)
+
+    await page.getByRole('combobox', { name: /size/i }).selectOption({ label: /^(8|9)$/ })
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /add to cart|add to bag/i }).click()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText(/added|cart/i)
+  })
+
+  test('toggles the wishlist state with a heart button', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    const wishlist = page.getByRole('button', { name: /wishlist|save/i })
+    await expect(wishlist).toBeAPGToggleButton()
+    await wishlist.click()
+    await expect(wishlist).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true')
+    await wishlist.click()
+    await expect(wishlist).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false')
+  })
+
+  test('shows one product-information section at a time', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    const tabs = page.getByRole('tablist', { name: /product information|more information/i })
+    await expect(tabs).toBeAPGTabs()
+    await tabs.getByRole('tab', { name: /reviews/i }).click()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('tabpanel')).toContainText(/review/i)
+  })
+
+  test('hides common answers until each question is opened', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    const questions = page.getByRole('region', { name: /questions|faq/i })
+    await expect(questions).toBeAPGAccordion()
+    const question = questions.getByRole('button').first()
+    await expect(question).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false')
+    await question.click()
+    await expect(question).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true')
+    await expect(questions.getByRole('region').last()).toBeVisible()
+  })
+
+  test('includes help, company, and social links in the footer', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    const footer = page.getByRole('contentinfo')
+    await expect(footer).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(footer).toContainText(/help|customer service/i)
+    await expect(footer).toContainText(/company|about/i)
+    await expect(footer).toContainText(/social/i)
+  })
+
+  test('meets WCAG 2.2 AA requirements', async ({ page }) => {
+    await openProductPage(page)
+
+    await expect(page).toBeWCAGCompliant()
+  })
+})
